text:
Sam K.: Quick sync: PR #4899 adds a preflight checklist for private/on-prem installs. Needs a small KMS fallback example for air-gapped sites + a clear HSM verification step.

Priya M.: Link-checker flagged one dead anchor in the cert guide: /docs/private/certs#chain-verify -> 404. Also flag in TOC.

Docs Bot: link-checker: PR #4899 -> 1 broken anchor (/docs/private/certs#chain-verify). Please update to /docs/private/certs#verify-chain.

Luca V.: For HSM verification can we include the PKCS#11 slot list + a quick grep example? e.g. `p11tool --list-all | grep -i slot` and `pkcs11-tool --list-slots --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so` then verify slot ID in config.

Sam K.: Yes add that. Also add a one-line healthcheck for KMS endpoint: `curl --connect-timeout 5 -sS https://127.0.0.1:8443/healthz || echo 'kms down'` and note TLS cert pin caveat for air-gapped installs.

Priya M.: SDK snippet: include both Python and Go minimal fallbacks. Python env approach: `export RW_KMS=local && export RW_KMS_PATH=/var/lib/local-kms/keys` then `from rwinf_sdk import Client; c = Client()` (picks env). Go example: `os.Setenv("RW_KMS","local"); os.Setenv("RW_KMS_PATH","/var/lib/local-kms/keys"); client := rwinf.NewClient()` — keep it tiny.

Luca V.: Add note: local KMS must be run as a system service and the socket path must be readable by redwood user, e.g. `chown redwood:redwood /var/lib/local-kms -R`.

Sam K.: Migration/rollback checklist: before rolling back clear model metadata cache: `rwinf-admin cache flush --prefix=model:` and restart with graceful-restart pattern `sudo systemctl kill --signal=SIGTERM --kill-who=main redwood-inference; sleep 5; sudo systemctl start redwood-inference` (explain why SIGTERM preferred).

Priya M.: Also mention HSM ACLs: after rollback confirm PKCS11 token label matches `/etc/redwood/hsm.conf` and re-run `pkcs11-tool --login --slot <id>` to verify login works.

Taylor S.: Tiny docs wording nit: replace "restart" with "graceful restart" in the rollback guide and call out expected 45-90s outage depending on cache warmup.

Sam K.: Thanks — I'll patch the PR: fix the cert anchor, add the KMS healthcheck, both SDK snippets, HSM verification steps, and the cache flush. Will ping when CI/link-checker is green.

Docs Bot: automated-checks: CI passed with warnings (docs lint). link-checker: no broken links after changes.

Priya M.: I'll do a final pass on the Go snippet for idiomaticness. If all good, merge. :thumbsup:
